# Wasteland performance chems
These are chemical mixtures. Many performance chems can cause addiction or adverse effects; producing a mixture does not make it safe to combine or overdose.
## Jet
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u ammonia + 1u Abraxo Cleaner
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u jet.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Increases movement speed; Applies seeing rainbows; Causes poison damage; Causes jittering; Can cause addiction; At 30u or more: Removes stun; At 30u or more: Removes knockdown. ## Mentats
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u Abraxo Cleaner + 1u lead
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u mentats.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Perception +2, Intelligence +2); Can cause addiction. ## Berry mentats
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u mentats + 1u tarberry juice
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u berry mentats.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes jittering; Can cause addiction. ## Grape mentats
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u mentats + 1u whiskey
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u grape mentats.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes jittering; Can cause addiction. ## Orange mentats
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u mentats + 1u carrot juice
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u orange mentats.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes jittering; Can cause addiction. ## Hydra
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u scorpion tail + 1u fungus extract + 1u nightstalker blood
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u Hydra.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies incoming damage protection; Can cause addiction; Causes jittering; At 22u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage. ## Psycho
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u bloatfly acid + 2u broc flower extract + 1u blood + 2u Antiseptic
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u psycho.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Can cause addiction; Increases movement speed; At 30u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage. ## Turbo
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u cazador acid + 1u broc flower extract + 1u jet + 1u Turpentine
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u turbo.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Increases movement speed; Causes poison damage; Causes jittering; Can cause addiction; At 12u or more: Removes stun; At 12u or more: Removes knockdown; At 15u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage. ## Buffout
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u uncooked animal proteins + 1u Fire ant nectar + 1u Antiseptic
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u buffout.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Can cause addiction; Heals brute, burn damage; At 30u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage; Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +2). ## Buffjet
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u jet + 1u buffout
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u buffjet.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage; Causes jittering; Increases movement speed; Can cause addiction; Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +2, Agility +2). ## Bufftats
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u mentats + 1u buffout
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u bufftats.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Can cause addiction; Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +2, Perception +2). ## Med-x
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u Wonderglue + 2u white horsenettle extract + 1u ethanol
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u med-x.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies incoming damage protection; Causes jittering; At 30u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage; Suppresses chronic pain. ## Fixer
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u buffalo gourd juice + 1u irradiated fungus extract + 1u saline
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u fixer.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes drunk; Heals poison damage; Suppresses addiction. ## Cateye
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u carrot juice + 2u welding fuel + 1u silver
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u cateye.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Grants night vision; can cause addiction. ## Rushing water
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u jet + 1u water + 1u fixer
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u rushing water.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Increases movement speed; Heals brute, burn damage; Causes jittering. ## Daytripper
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u mentats + 1u Nuka-Cola + 1u ethanol + 1u sugar
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u daytripper.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies seeing rainbows; Can cause addiction. ## Fury
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u Berserker Mixture + 2u buffout + 1u med-x
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 340 K (66.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u fury.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +7); Applies incoming damage protection; Can cause addiction; Increases feralization progression; Causes jittering; Increases bleeding; At 6u or more: Causes poison damage. ## Calmex
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u mentats + 2u med-x + 1u daytripper + 1u ethanol
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u calmex.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Perception +3, Agility +3); Can cause addiction. ## Overdrive
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u sulfuric acid + 2u Nuka-Cola + 2u psycho + 1u epinephrine
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 340 K (66.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u overdrive.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +4, Luck +3); Can cause addiction; Causes jittering; At 11u or more: Causes poison damage. ## X-cell
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u buffout + 2u mentats + 2u daytripper + 2u rad-x + 2u epinephrine + 1u med-x + 1u turbo + 2u Berserker Mixture + 1u Promethine
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u x-cell.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Strength +2, Perception +2, Endurance +2, Charisma +2, Intelligence +2, Agility +2, Luck +2); Can cause addiction; At 6u or more: Causes poison damage. ## Crank
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u epinephrine + 1u ammonia + 1u ethanol
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u crank.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Increases movement speed; Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Agility +3); Removes drowsiness; Causes jittering; Can cause addiction; Causes poison damage; At 11u or more: Causes poison, asphyxiation damage. ## Clearwake
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u epinephrine + 1u Nuka-Cola + 1u jet
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u clearwake.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes drowsiness; Removes stun; Removes knockdown; Heals asphyxiation damage; Causes poison damage; Causes jittering; At 11u or more: Causes poison, asphyxiation damage; Resets the narcolepsy timer. ## Berserker mixture
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u healing powder + 1u white horsenettle extract + 1u glowpepper juice + 1u nettle juice
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u Berserker Mixture.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, brute damage; Reduces bleeding; Increases movement speed; Applies seeing rainbows; At 5u or more: Removes stun; At 5u or more: Removes knockdown; At 26u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage.
